scheme_name: Monetary Relief to the Victim of Atrocities- Haryana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana
Applicant must be a victim or a family member/dependent of a victim of an atrocity committed by non‑Scheduled Caste persons
An FIR must be lodged under the SC/ST Prevention of Atrocities Act, 1989
benefits_summary: Financial assistance ranging from ₹85,000 to ₹8,25,000 is provided to victims of atrocities belonging to Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes.
